body.message:
Dear Sabrin,

We completely understand your concern and appreciate you sharing your feedback. As you are aware, due to your long-term stay, we have been able to maintain the same rate for the past 4 consecutive months. However, the revised rate for the upcoming extension period has been provided by the management based on the current market conditions, and unfortunately, we are unable to override this decision.

Please note that this adjustment is not specific to your reservation; all our guests with upcoming extensions have been informed accordingly. We have also double-checked with the management regarding your case, and as a gesture of goodwill, instead of the 20% increase, we are able to offer you a revised increase of only 15%, which is the best possible rate we can provide.

We truly appreciate your understanding and continued stay with us. Should you wish to proceed with the extension, please let us know, and we will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you.
